a.lede: Tesla has finally unveiled the next-generation Roadster.
a.title: Tesla's redesigned Roadster has a cold-gas thruster option, but you'll need $250,000 just to reserve it

b.title: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style
